buildCommand:
readonly stream=2.4.0
readonly revision=1+git.12ca20e67b51
readonly out=/src/nvkr-output
readonly charts="$out/charts"
readonly images="$out/images"
readonly image_dir="$images/usr/lib/nke/cni-ovn/$stream"
readonly image_name="ovn-images_${stream}_linux_{{.Arch}}.tgz"
mkdir -p "$charts/DEBIAN" "$charts/etc/dgx/ovn-kubernetes" "$images/DEBIAN" "$image_dir" "$out/debs"
tar -xf /nvkr/inputs/materials/ovn-chart -C "$charts/etc/dgx"
test -f "$charts/etc/dgx/ovn-kubernetes/Chart.yaml"
grep -qx "version: $stream" "$charts/etc/dgx/ovn-kubernetes/Chart.yaml"
# Fork-specific keys: the old upstream global.image override does not apply.
cat >"$charts/etc/dgx/ovn-kubernetes/values-nke.yaml" <<'EOF'
global:
  skipCallToK8s: true
  imagePullSecretName: ""
  useImageDigest: false
ovnkube-control-plane:
  ovnkubeControlPlane:
    image: &built_image
      repository: localhost/nvke/ovn-kubernetes
      tag: git-12ca20e67b516f1a023da85a22deeaf8d2d70d0b
      sha256: ""
ovnkube-single-node-zone:
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZone:
    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneNbdb:
    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneSbdb:
    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneNorthd:
    image: *built_image
  ovnkubeSingleNodeZoneOvnHost:
    image: *built_image
EOF
for kind in charts images; do
  root="$out/$kind"
  cat >"$root/DEBIAN/control" <<EOF
Package: nke-cni-ovn-$kind-$stream
Version: $revision
Architecture: {{.Arch}}
Maintainer: NKE <nke-dev@exchange.nvidia.com>
Provides: nke-cni-ovn-$kind
Conflicts: nke-cni-ovn-$kind
Description: NVKE OVN $kind from pinned DSX source
EOF
done
printf 'Depends: containerd | nke-kubeadm-distro\n' >>"$images/DEBIAN/control"
gzip -n -9 -c /nvkr/inputs/materials/ovn-image >"$image_dir/$image_name"
(cd "$image_dir" && sha256sum "$image_name" >"$image_name.sha256")
# Preserve the offline containerd import contract and fail configuration
# on checksum, readiness or import errors.
cat >"$images/DEBIAN/postinst" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
set -euo pipefail
[ "${1:-}" = configure ] || exit 0
readonly image_dir=/usr/lib/nke/cni-ovn/2.4.0
readonly image_name=ovn-images_2.4.0_linux_{{.Arch}}.tgz
if [ -n "${NKE_CTR_BIN:-}" ]; then
  ctr="$(command -v "$NKE_CTR_BIN")" || { echo "OVN import: ctr is not executable: $NKE_CTR_BIN" >&2; exit 1; }
elif [ -x /usr/local/bin/ctr ]; then
  ctr=/usr/local/bin/ctr
else
  ctr="$(command -v ctr)" || { echo 'OVN import: ctr not found' >&2; exit 1; }
fi
[ -f "$ctr" ] && [ -x "$ctr" ] || { echo "OVN import: ctr is not executable: $ctr" >&2; exit 1; }
readonly ctr
readonly log=/var/log/nke-cni-ovn-postinst.log
cd "$image_dir"
sha256sum --strict -c "$image_name.sha256"
ready=false
for ((n=0; n<50; n++)); do
  if timeout --kill-after=1s 2s "$ctr" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ready=true; break
  fi
  sleep 0.2
done
"$ready" || { echo 'OVN import: containerd readiness timed out' >&2; exit 1; }
gzip -dc "$image_name" | timeout --kill-after=5s 300s "$ctr" -n k8s.io images import - >>"$log" 2>&1 \
  || { echo "OVN import failed; see $log" >&2; exit 1; }
EOF
chmod 0755 "$images/DEBIAN/postinst"
for kind in charts images; do
  root="$out/$kind"
  find "$root" -print0 | xargs -0 touch -h -d "@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"
  dpkg-deb --root-owner-group --uniform-compression -Zxz -z6 --build "$root" \
    "$out/debs/nke-cni-ovn-${kind}-${stream}_${revision}_{{.Arch}}.deb"
done
tar --format=ustar --sort=name --mtime="@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" --owner=0 --group=0 \
  --numeric-owner -C "$out/debs" -cf "$out/nvke-cni-ovn.tar" .

echo 'OVN IMAGE BUILD: source-owned Dockerfile acquires OVS/OVN and kubectl through APT; not hermetic or NV FIPS/STIG.' >&2
exec buildctl-daemonless.sh build --frontend dockerfile.v0 \
  --local context=/src --local dockerfile=/src/dist/images \
  --opt filename=Dockerfile.ubuntu.nv --opt platform=linux/{{.Arch}} \
  --opt build-arg:OVN_KUBERNETES_DIR=. \
  --opt build-arg:BUILDER_IMAGE=quay.io/projectquay/golang@sha256:506a668eb4c763a964ffc4d4ad0125d45d75aac899392be7e5d39380f8452564 \
  --opt build-arg:BASE_IMAGE=docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04@sha256:534baea6a22c03a63003dbc8dbe78fe34bc0d7e595d9a9dc9834884ff530eb55 \
  --opt "build-arg:SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" \
  --opt build-arg:OVS_SOURCE=doca \
  --opt build-arg:OVN_SOURCE=uca \
  --opt build-arg:CLOUD_ARCHIVE=gazpacho \
  --opt build-arg:UCA_OVN_VER=26.03.0-2~cloud0 \
  --opt build-arg:DOCA_RELEASE=3.5.0 \
  --opt build-arg:K8S_VER=v1.36 \
  --output type=oci,dest=/src/nvkr-output/ovn-kube-ubuntu.oci.tar,oci-mediatypes=true,rewrite-timestamp=true,name=localhost/nvke/ovn-kubernetes:git-12ca20e67b516f1a023da85a22deeaf8d2d70d0b

readonly chart=/src/charts/ovn-kubernetes
readonly out=/src/nvkr-output/ovn-kubernetes
test -f "$chart/Chart.yaml"
grep -qx 'version: 2.4.0' "$chart/Chart.yaml"
mkdir -p "$out"
cp -a "$chart/." "$out/"
# The pinned chart aliases upstream's values filename onto values.yaml.
test "$(readlink "$out/values-single-node-zone.yaml")" = values.yaml
rm "$out/values-single-node-zone.yaml"
test ! -e "$out/values-single-node-zone.yaml"
tar --format=ustar --sort=name --mtime="@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" --owner=0 --group=0 \
  --numeric-owner -C /src/nvkr-output -cf /src/nvkr-output/ovn-kubernetes-chart.tar ovn-kubernetes

set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C LANG=C TZ=UTC
out=/src/nvkr-output
stage="$out/image-inputs"
package=/nvkr/inputs/materials/nvsentinel
test -f "$package"
test "$(dpkg-deb --field "$package" Architecture)" = '{{.Arch}}'
package_bytes=$(stat -c %s "$package")
test "$package_bytes" -gt 0
test "$package_bytes" -le 1073741824
python3 /src/os-image/packer/scripts/compose-image-inputs.py \
  --architecture {{.Arch}} \
  --materials-dir /nvkr/inputs/materials \
  --source-files-dir /src/os-image/files \
  --output "$out/base-image-inputs.tar" \
  --source-date-epoch "$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"
mkdir "$stage"
tar -xf "$out/base-image-inputs.tar" -C "$stage"
test ! -e "$stage/debs/nvsentinel-platform-connectors.deb"
install -m 0644 "$package" "$stage/debs/nvsentinel-platform-connectors.deb"
install -m 0644 /src/os-image/files/99-disable-network-config.cfg "$stage/"
install -m 0600 /src/os-image/files/00-dhcp-all.yaml "$stage/"
total_bytes=$(find "$stage" -type f -name '*.deb' -printf '%s\n' | awk '{total += $1} END {printf "%.0f", total}')
test "$total_bytes" -le 7516192768
test "$(find "$stage/debs" -type f -name '*.deb' -printf '.\n' | wc -l)" -le 16384
(cd "$stage/debs" && timeout --kill-after=10s 300s dpkg-scanpackages --multiversion . /dev/null >Packages)
chmod 0644 "$stage/debs/Packages"
tar --format=ustar --sort=name --mtime="@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" \
  --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner -C "$stage" -cf "$out/image-inputs.tar" .
